name: Integrity
overview: Scripture reveals integrity as a steadfast commitment to truthfulness and moral uprightness, even under pressure or temptation. Abraham's honesty about Sarah, despite potential danger (Genesis 12:18), and Isaac's cautious truthfulness with Abimelech (Genesis 26:9) exemplify this. Joseph's refusal to sin with Potiphar's wife (Genesis 39:8) and his innocence despite false accusations (Genesis 40:15) further demonstrate integrity as faithfulness to God's standards. Additionally, Jacob's honest accounting of losses (Genesis 31:39) shows integrity in stewardship, highlighting that integrity encompasses both personal conduct and responsibility towards others.
